items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: Murray Henderson, when Murray Henderson died, you know how many bands they had? They had all the bands in the city.

ctx.x: Murray Henderson, when Murray Henderson died, you know how many bands they had? They had all the bands in the city. That must have been about 12 or 14 bands. Had all the bands. They had the biggest funeral they ever had. Who was it again? Murray Henderson. Murray Henderson. Yeah, got the Undertaker over there on Tash.
